title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
hints: Think about what complement you need for each number
A hash map can store values you've already seen

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Track character positions with a map

title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Given two strings text1 and text2, return the length of their longest common subsequence.
hints: If characters match, add 1 to diagonal

title: Number of Islands
description: Given an m x n 2D binary grid which represents a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.
hints: Use DFS or BFS to explore connected land cells
Mark visited cells to avoid counting them again

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
description: Given a binary tree, find the maximum path sum. A path is any sequence of nodes connected by edges.
hints: At each node, decide whether to extend the path or start a new one

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
hints: Or use divide and conquer to merge pairs
